findings.detail: Admiral Buyer row has no stated interest-rate cell, but the source provides Reference Rate and Spread S + 5.50%, so basis_spread should not be blank.

rationale: Class 2 row-level review. The pipeline flagged three PRIVATE_CREDIT rows as having neither interest_rate nor basis_spread. In the raw SOI, all three matching rows have blank Interest Rate cells but visible Reference Rate and Spread cells: S + 5.50%, S + 6.00%, and S + 4.75%. Therefore the absence of interest_rate alone is source-consistent, but the missing basis_spread is a real extraction/localization error.
